# Synthetic model cards — DC reference (brief-gdf-1b R-gdf1b-5)

`cards.lib` holds a level-1 diode split into an area card and a perimeter card, a level-1 NPN, a PNP and a
sheet-resistance card, in the shapes open process kits use and with none of their numbers. `bench.sp` puts
every card into one DC operating point in the SPICE dialect; `bench.cnl` is the same circuit as circuitRF
builds it from those cards. Each zero-volt source is an ammeter in series with one device terminal.

**The reference is not here yet.** It must be generated by an independent simulator of the SPICE dialect,
outside this repository, from `bench.sp` unchanged, and committed beside it as fixed data: every node
voltage and every ammeter current. A reference circuitRF produced itself proves nothing.

Gate, once it exists: node voltages and terminal currents within 1e-6 relative, or 1 nV / 1 pA absolute
below that.
